chunks: We were told by my father, may Allah be pleased with him, that he said: We were told by Abdullah bin Hasan, the Teacher, from Ahmad bin Ali al-Esbahani, from Ibrahim bin Muhammad, that he said: We were informed by Hakam bin Sulayman, that he said: We were told by Yahya bin Ya'la al-Aslami, from Hussain bin Zaid al-Jazri, from Shaddad al-Basri, from 'Ataa' bin Abi Rabah, from Anas bin Malik, that he said:

The Messenger of Allah, Allah’s blessings be upon him and his Family, said: When I was ascended to Heaven, I was suddenly by a column whose origin is of white silver, its center is of ruby and peridot, and its top is of red gold. So I said: O Jibra'eel, what is this? He said: This is your Religion, white, clear, brightening. I said: And what is this at its center? He said: Striving. I said: And what is this red gold? He said: Migration. Therefore, the faith of Ali, peace be upon him, was elevated above the faith of every believer.
ai.seo_question: What does the column seen by the Prophet during the Ascension symbolize regarding Ali's faith?
ai.summary: In *Mani al-Akhbar*, Shaykh al-Saduq records this vision where the column's structure symbolizes the hierarchy of Islamic virtues: the silver base represents the clarity of the Deen, the ruby center signifies Jihad, and the red gold apex denotes Hijrah. The narration concludes by linking this celestial symbolism to the supremacy of Imam Ali’s faith over all other believers, a key theme in Shia exegesis of the Mi'raj.
